title: Classical curve inverse image preserves a prescribed filtration
statement: Fix a finite-field datum $D$ with base $k_0$, algebraic closure $k$ and geometric Frobenius [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne p$, and an algebraic closure $\Omega:\operatorname{Type}(u+1)$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$. Let $X_0$ be a separated finite-type $k_0$-scheme, $m\ge1$, $k_m=\mathbf F_{q^m}\subset k$, and $h_0:C_0\to X_0\times_{k_0}k_m$ a morphism with $C_0$ separated and finite type over $k_m$. Use the common-stage constructible Weil heart [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex; def-weil-constructible-heart], classical lisse Weil sheaves and filtrations [def-zl-classical-weil-filtration-transport-data], and normalized classical realization [def-zl-normalized-classical-weil-realization]. Let $R$ be a common-stage restriction functor, $R_X,R_C$ normalized realizations, and $c$ any $\mathrm{ZlCurveClassicalPullback}$ comparison [def-zl-curve-restriction-filtration-data]. Suppose additionally that for every algebraically closed geometric point $x$ on $(C_0)_k$ the fibre functor after $c_{\rm classical}$ is naturally isomorphic to the original fibre functor at $xh$. For every classical filtration $F$ of length $r$ and every algebraically closed geometric point $x$ of $(C_0)_k$, the fibre of $c_{\rm classical}(F_0)$ is zero, and for every $j<r$ the images of the prescribed inclusion and quotient arrows form an injective, exact and surjective sequence on that fibre. These are the zero and exactness proof fields for the classical filtration whose terms, quotients and arrows are defined by $c_{\rm classical}$. This assertion includes $r=0$ and asserts no heart transport or local operator formula.

proof.text: At a geometric point x, choose the supplied natural fibre comparison β. Its component at F.terms 0 transfers subsingletonness by injectivity of a linear equivalence. For each j, naturality supplies both arrow squares; the private linear-algebra helper transports injectivity, image-kernel equality and surjectivity from F.exact along the three component isomorphisms. This proves the zero and exactness fields of the prescribed image diagram without changing any terms or maps.

proof_origin.place: Elementary linear transport along the ordinary geometric fibre natural isomorphisms; BS 6.8.4 and blueprint paragraph 2.

theorem zl_curve_classical_filtration_pullback
    (R : sfCommonStageWeilSheaf D l hl X₀ Ω ⥤
      sfCommonStageWeilSheaf (constantExtensionDatum D m hm) l hl
        (constantExtensionModel D m hm X₀) Ω)
    (RX : ZlClassicalRealization D l hl Ω X₀)
    (RC : ZlClassicalRealization (constantExtensionDatum D m hm) l hl Ω C₀)
    (c : ZlCurveClassicalPullback D l hl Ω X₀ m hm C₀ h₀ RX RC R)
    (hFib : ∀ (κ : Type u) [Field κ] [IsAlgClosed κ]
        (x : Spec (.of κ) ⟶ ((constantExtensionDatum D m hm).geometricFiber C₀).left),
      Nonempty (c.classical ⋙
          IsoAlgebra.forget (lisseAlgebraicAutomorphismPullback
            ((constantExtensionDatum D m hm).geometricFrobenius C₀) l Ω) ⋙
          lisseAlgebraicFiberFunctor l
            ((constantExtensionDatum D m hm).geometricFiber C₀).left x Ω ≅
        IsoAlgebra.forget (lisseAlgebraicAutomorphismPullback
            (D.geometricFrobenius X₀) l Ω) ⋙
          lisseAlgebraicFiberFunctor l (D.geometricFiber X₀).left
            (x ≫ zlCurveGeometricMap D X₀ m hm C₀ h₀) Ω))
    (r : ℕ) (F : ZlClassicalFiltration D l Ω X₀ r) :
    ∀ (κ : Type u) [Field κ] [IsAlgClosed κ]
      (x : Spec (.of κ) ⟶ ((constantExtensionDatum D m hm).geometricFiber C₀).left),
    Subsingleton ((lisseAlgebraicFiberFunctor l
        ((constantExtensionDatum D m hm).geometricFiber C₀).left x Ω).obj
      (c.classical.obj (F.terms 0)).carrier) ∧
    ∀ j : Fin r,
      Function.Injective ((lisseAlgebraicFiberFunctor l
        ((constantExtensionDatum D m hm).geometricFiber C₀).left x Ω).map
        (c.classical.map (F.inclusion j)).hom.f) ∧
      Function.Exact ((lisseAlgebraicFiberFunctor l
        ((constantExtensionDatum D m hm).geometricFiber C₀).left x Ω).map
        (c.classical.map (F.inclusion j)).hom.f)
        ((lisseAlgebraicFiberFunctor l
          ((constantExtensionDatum D m hm).geometricFiber C₀).left x Ω).map
          (c.classical.map (F.quotient j)).hom.f) ∧
      Function.Surjective ((lisseAlgebraicFiberFunctor l
        ((constantExtensionDatum D m hm).geometricFiber C₀).left x Ω).map
        (c.classical.map (F.quotient j)).hom.f)
